extension.description: Lightweight SpringBoot code navigation for VS Code, powered by a Rust/napi-rs native index.
config.title: SpringNav
config.defaultDirection.description: Jump direction used by Ctrl/Cmd+Click (Go to Definition entry): down = Go to Java Definition (reference -> declaration), up = Go to Java Reference.
config.fallbackOnEmpty.description: When a direction (definition or reference) has no match, automatically fall back to the opposite direction for one level.
